issues.issue: A budget-to-actual schedule is printed but none of its lines are in detail. The no-double-counting rule applies between detail schedules, not between detail and the basic statements, so this schedule should have been captured. Its disbursement lines are by function and fund and can each be given a fund_type (Electric, Water, Sewer and Sanitation are business-type). Some receipt lines (Charges for services, Interest, Other) combine both fund types and would need a review flag.
